findings.current: A sword reduced to its hilt. Tightly pressed lips.
findings.defect: The source states that both the sword and the saber were reduced to their hilts, but the draft mentions only a sword.
findings.rationale: 도검 collectively identifies the two combatants’ sword and saber; omitting the saber changes the physical result of their clash.
findings.replacement: A sword and saber reduced to nothing but their hilts. Tightly pressed lips.
findings.source: 손잡이만 남은 도검과 굳게 다문 입술.

findings.current: I had lost the first subordinate I’d gained in the Murim, and I’d nearly died.
findings.defect: The draft says the casualty was the first subordinate Taekyung had recruited, whereas the source says this was the first time he had lost one of his Murim subordinates.
findings.rationale: 처음으로 modifies 잃었고, describing Taekyung’s first experience of losing a subordinate rather than identifying that subordinate as the first one recruited.
findings.replacement: For the first time, I’d lost one of the subordinates I’d gained in the Murim, and I’d nearly died.
findings.source: 무림에서 얻은 수하를 처음으로 잃었고, 죽기 직전까지 갔으니까.

findings.current: The sight of the earth splitting wide open without a single boom or tremor was pure terror.
findings.defect: “Pure terror” narrows 전율 to fear and adds an emotional judgment not specified by the source, which presents the silent destruction as shudder-inducing.
findings.rationale: 전율 conveys an involuntary thrill or shudder and does not necessarily mean terror.
findings.replacement: The sight of the earth splitting wide open without a single boom or tremor sent a shiver through him.
findings.source: 어떤 굉음도, 진동도 없이 지면이 쩍 갈라지는 광경은 전율 그 자체였다.

findings.defect: The draft loses the deliberately polite, tentative phrasing that makes Taekyung’s insult deadpan and comic.
findings.rationale: 혹시 and the polite ending -세요 turn the blunt insult 미친놈 into a mock-courteous question; that register contrast is intentional characterization and humor.
findings.replacement: “Are you, by any chance, a lunatic?”

findings.current: He had been the most powerful and hopeless opponent I had ever faced.
findings.defect: “Hopeless opponent” naturally suggests that the Head Elder himself was ineffectual or beyond saving, rather than that facing him made Taekyung feel hopeless.
findings.rationale: 절망적이었던 describes how overwhelmingly hopeless the opponent made the confrontation feel, not a lack of ability on the opponent’s part.
findings.replacement: He had been the most powerful and despair-inducing opponent I had ever faced.
findings.source: 지금까지 만난 무인 중 가장 고강하고 절망적이었던 상대.

findings.current: “You should have seen who you were attacking before you charged in.”
findings.defect: The draft is an unnatural literal rendering and obscures the idiomatic warning that Taekyung should have judged his opponent before attacking.
findings.rationale: 사람을 보고 덤비다 means to size up or choose one’s opponent before starting a fight, not literally to see who is being attacked.
findings.replacement: “You should’ve picked your opponent more carefully before charging in.”

summary: The draft contains two factual distortions and several meaningful losses of emotional or comedic register.
